$Comment: Christmas Morning: a present waits for every player under Santa's tree, once a year. The _Christmas
folder makes the id christmas_morning. Its own Season, Christmas_Morning, replaces the base's, so it
shows only while the calendar event Christmas_Morning runs (December 25 to January 10) and hides the
rest of Christmas. Flow.AutoAccept puts it in every player's quest log while that event runs, at their
next login or world change, and the base's Flow.AutoTrack pins it to their tracker; it asks for nothing
earlier in the story, so a player who only just arrived gets it too.
The one step is a TURN_IN with a blank Target, handed in at Santa: nothing to bring, only the walk.
Santa's conversation opens on his morning line while it is carried, and its answer hands it in; a
player whose quest log was full takes it from the same line. Repeat.PerRun brings it back once in each
Its pay is direct rows, waiting to be collected like every quest's: Christmas Coins, festival tokens,
the game's red-dotted Christmas Packet (sold nowhere), a Santa Suit to wear, and a little favor on
Santa's Nice List and Festival Favor.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Acrobatics XP for the walk to the temple, collected with the rest.
Its own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on a server without that mod,
unpaid and unshown, and the rest still pays.
Name: Morning
